question.text: A microwave of wavelength 2.0 cm falls normally on a slit of width 4.0 cm . The angular spread of the central maxima of the diffraction pattern obtained on a screen 1.5 m away from the slit, will be:

solution.text:
Condition for minima is $\mathrm{d} \sin \theta=\mathrm{n} \lambda$
For Ist minimad $\sin \theta=\lambda$
$\sin \theta=\frac{\lambda}{a}=\frac{2}{4}=\frac{1}{2} \quad \therefore \theta=30^{\circ}$
Angular spread $=2 \theta=60^{\circ}$
